gap: No result ChatGPT got states, from the maker's own pages, that the cameras it recommended stop taking solar charge at 0 °C (32 °F) even though they are rated to keep running far colder: eufy SoloCam S340 charges at 0–40 °C but operates down to −20 °C, and Reolink's Solar Panel 2 charges at 0–45 °C while the Argus 4 Pro operates down to −10 °C. It also isn't stated that Reolink's Solar Panel 2S, which has a built-in 5,900 mAh battery, keeps the camera powered from 0 °C down to −20 °C.
standout_why: Compared against all four cited rivals. SafeWise (cited in chat 1) has one hedged line: "the battery probably won't charge below 32º F". It gives no maker figure and isn't about the 2026 picks; it covers the Argus 3 Pro, Arlo Pro 3, eufyCam 3 and older models. Bob Vila (cited twice) says only that winter days are shorter. HomeGearLab (cited in chat 2) and RottenWiFi (cited in chat 1) give operating ranges for eufy, Ring and the Argus 4 Pro (−4 °F or 14 °F lows), which suggest the cameras work fine in winter, and never give a charging range. RottenWiFi's only cold-charging line is for a Tapo C402 it doesn't pick. None of the four mentions the Reolink Solar Panel 2S or any battery-buffered panel as the fix for freezing weather.
decides: For shoppers where winter days stay below freezing, the 6 W Solar Panel 2 bundled with the Argus 4 Pro and Argus Eco Ultra, and the S340's built-in panel, put no charge into the camera on sub-freezing days. The camera runs down its own battery until a day above 0 °C. That doesn't change the pick for mild climates, where the Argus 4 Pro or S340 is fine. For cold climates it changes which panel to buy: for a Reolink camera, choose the Solar Panel 2S, whose internal battery recharges down to −10 °C and powers the camera from 0 °C to −20 °C. The Argus 4 Pro itself is rated only to −10 °C (14 °F), so the camera, not the panel, is the cold limit there. Reolink also lists the original Argus, Keen and Doorbell (Battery) as unsupported by its panels. eufy has no equivalent in what I read, so S340 owners in cold areas get no solar charge below freezing.
candidates: Reolink Argus 4 Pro + Solar Panel 2 (6 W)
Reolink Solar Panel 2S (6 W, 5,900 mAh built-in battery)
Reolink Argus Eco Ultra + Solar Panel 2

findings.label: Charging temperature when the panel charges a camera
findings.source_title: Reolink Solar Panels Not Working (Reolink Support)
findings.note: Exact text: "the charging temperature is 0°C to 45°C (32°F to 113°F). Charging may temporarily stop when the current temperature is below 0°C to protect the lithium battery... charging will automatically resume once the temperature returns to normal."

findings.label: Charging cutoff, restated in Reolink's efficiency guide
findings.source_title: Understanding and Optimizing Reolink Solar Panel Efficiency
findings.note: Exact text: "the camera won't be charged if the temperature drops below 0°C (32°F)." The same page gives Solar Panel 2S operating −20 °C to +58 °C and says the built-in battery "can be charged at temperatures as low as -10°C".

findings.label: Behaviour below freezing
findings.value: From 0 °C down to −20 °C, the built-in battery powers the camera directly instead of charging it; above 0 °C it charges the camera
findings.note: Exact text: "the built-in battery of the Solar Panel 2S (if it has remaining power) will directly power the camera". Same article: built-in 5,900 mAh (42.48 Wh) battery, USB-C port, 4 m cable, applies to "All Reolink battery-powered cameras except Reolink Argus, Keen, and Reolink Doorbell (Battery)".

findings.label: Battery capacity, weatherproofing and compatible cameras (US product page)
findings.value: 5,900 mAh / 42.48 Wh; IP67; names Argus 4 Pro as supported
findings.note: The product page says it "works between -10℃ and 50℃", narrower than the support article's −20 °C powering figure. Use −10 °C as the conservative low. No USD price was shown on reolink.com or reolink.com/us.

findings.label: Operating temperature, battery and port
findings.value: −10 °C to 55 °C (14 °F to 131 °F); 5,000 mAh battery; USB-C; lists Solar Panel 2 (6 W) as its solar option
findings.note: No charging temperature is printed on the product page; the 0 °C charging limit comes from Reolink's solar support articles above. The camera's −10 °C operating floor sets the cold limit even when it's paired with the 2S.

findings.label: Charging temperature vs operating temperature
findings.source_title: eufy Security SoloCam S340 Guía de Inicio Rápido (ManualsLib mirror of eufy's quick start guide)
findings.note: Exact text: "The suitable temperature for this device and accessories is -20°C to 50°C (Charging temperature is 0°C to 40°C)." This is a mirror of the manufacturer's quick start guide, not eufy.com; the manuals.plus copy returned 403. So between 0 °C and −20 °C the S340 keeps recording but its built-in panel adds no charge.
